entries.speaker: Making Use of Hangout Spots
entries.en: There are a number of [clr 2]hangout spots[clr 27] in the city,[n]such as shops, event venues, landmarks and so on.

entries.speaker: Making Use of Hangout Spots
entries.en: Confidants will each have their own favorite hangout[n]spot. If you go there with them, your bond will grow[n]even deeper than it normally would.

entries.speaker: Making Use of Hangout Spots
entries.en: You can learn about hangout spots by having[n]Confidants invite you there or by reading about[n]them in books. Try to find as many as you can.
